items.html: However, since the body of man is divided into two parts, as is known, for down to the chest the Yesod of Bina expands and the lights within it are covered, and from the chest downward the lights are revealed, as explained by us in the secret of the Hassadim that expand in Tifferet of ZA, hence his body is divided between two worlds: his covered upper half is placed in the six lower [Sefirot] of Yetzira, and his revealed lower half is placed in the four first [Sefirot] of Assiya. And thus it is found that the main of his body was above, in Yetzira, as is known that the body alludes to the Vav of the name HaVaYaH, and Yetzira itself is also alluded to by the letter Vav.
